REAP Admin API (0.1.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

License: Proprietary

Internal admin API contract for reap-admin-ui and admin-api-server.

This surface is intentionally separate from public APIs and is the canonical contract for privileged internal operations.

Security posture

  • Accept only internal admin JWTs (distinct audience/issuer from customer tokens).
  • Enforce role-based authorization for every operation.
  • All write operations require reason/ticket metadata and must emit immutable audit events.

Baseline roles

  • admin.readonly: read-only access.
  • admin.ops: operational actions (role-gated write operations).
  • admin.super: tenant-impacting or high-risk actions.

AdminIdentity

Internal admin actor and effective role context.

Get current admin actor

Returns the authenticated internal admin principal and effective roles.

Authorizations:
AdminBearerAuth

Responses

https://admin-api.reap.cloud/admin/v1/me

Search organizations (cross-tenant)

Server-side organization search and filtering.

Supported search dimensions:

  • id
  • name
  • domain
  • connectorId
  • userEmail

Use searchField=auto (default) for best-effort matching across all supported dimensions.

Authorizations:
AdminBearerAuth
query Parameters
q
string

Search text for organization lookup.

searchField
string
Default: "auto"
Enum: "auto" "id" "name" "domain" "connectorId" "userEmail"

Restricts search to one field, or auto to match across supported fields.

orgId
string <uuid>

Exact org id fast-path lookup.

label
Array of strings

Repeatable key:value org label selectors.

status
string (AdminOrgStatus)
Enum: "active" "soft_locked" "disabled"
sort
string

Server-side sort keys as a comma-separated list. Prefix a key with - for descending order (example: -updatedAt,name).

limit
integer [ 1 .. 200 ]
Default: 50
after
string
before
string

Responses

https://admin-api.reap.cloud/admin/v1/orgs

Get connector runtime metrics (admin)

Returns compact connector VM runtime health for otel-agent, command-agent, and connector VPN. The response includes live chart series from Prometheus Infra plus Grafana dashboard and embed links. By default the response is scoped to all reporting connectors in the organization. When connector VM metrics expose connector_id, callers may pass connectorId to scope the same native health panels and Grafana links to one connector. The connector selector payload includes connector names when they are available.

Authorizations:
AdminBearerAuth
path Parameters
orgId
required
string <uuid>
query Parameters
window
string
Default: "1h"
Enum: "15m" "30m" "1h" "3h" "6h" "12h" "24h" "7d"

Live metrics time window.

connectorId
string

Optional connector id. When present, all returned metrics and Grafana links are scoped to that connector.

Responses

https://admin-api.reap.cloud/admin/v1/orgs/{orgId}/connector-runtime-metrics

AdminConnectors

Connector fleet operations, rollouts, and remote diagnostics.

Preview or apply a ring-based connector upgrade

Thin v1 upgrade orchestration resolves target connectors from the current inventory view and reassigns their upgradeRing. When dryRun=true, the endpoint returns a blast-radius preview without mutating connectors.

path Parameters

reason

integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
